entities.summary: Roger Ward Babson was an American entrepreneur, Georgist economist, and business theorist in the first half of the 20th century. He is best remembered for predicting the Wall Street crash of 1929 and founding Babson College. He also founded Webber College in Babson Park, Florida, and the defunct Utopia College, in Eureka, Kansas.
